comparison.objective: Move a pot off a burner and switch the burner off; candidate adjusts a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Hot-object transfer and safety-control actuation versus precision fastener/collar manipulation and iterative impact tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Pot must be stable on the plate and burner switch off, with failure for a fallen or tipped pot; candidate must achieve repeatable bounded stopping.
comparison.reason: The common control-actuation and safety elements are generic and do not establish overlap.
